استغبيا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْبَيَا (istaḡbayā) /is.taɣ.ba.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اُسْتُغْبِيَا (ustuḡbiyā) /us.tuɣ.bi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# اِسْتَغْبِيَا (istaḡbiyā) /is.taɣ.bi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
